name: duopore-public-missed-day-recovery
description: Fit missed routine sessions into the extra time you choose for future days.

interface.longDescription: Fit missed routine sessions into the extra time you choose for future days. List the sessions you missed, their lengths and spare minutes you want to use. See which whole sessions fit and which still need time. For adults planning their own routine. The app does not guess missed days or add work beyond the time you choose.
defaultPrompt: Help me catch up on these missed sessions within my spare time.
Which missed routine sessions can fit into these future dates?

positive.prompt: Use Missed-day Recovery Schedule with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"routine":"Practice retrieval","asOf":"2026-10-04","minutesPerSession":15,"missedDates":["2026-10-01","2026-10-02","2026-10-03"],"futureSlots":[{"date":"2026-10-05","extraMinutes":20},{"date":"2026-10-06","extraMinutes":30}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"3 of 3 explicitly missed sessions placed; 0 remain unscheduled.","rows":[{"routine":"Practice retrieval","date":"2026-10-05","chosenExtraMinutes":20,"recoverySessions":1,"plannedExtraMinutes":15,"unusedExtraMinutes":5,"backlogAfterDate":2},{"routine":"Practice retrieval","date":"2026-10-06","chosenExtraMinutes":30,"recoverySessions":2,"plannedExtraMinutes":30,"unusedExtraMinutes":0,"backlogAfterDate":0}],"warnings":["Recovery uses only the extra capacity you chose; it does not change your baseline routine or infer unknown missed dates. Backlog may be left unscheduled."]}
